environment.required: Local NVIDIA Docker with compute,graphics,utility and JAX CUDA12; no host/MPS/cloud fallback
environment.driver: CUDA12-compatible NVIDIA driver; actual jax.devices and EGL render required. These planning budgets are not measured minima.
environment.sim_transitive_lock: Generated during first image build; unverified/unfrozen before that build

probe.prompt: Put the pear into the plate_seen
probe.scope: public dev instance; no holdout or benchmark estimate
probe.selection_rule: First public track_1 episode whose Fruit categories are all in task_config seen_object, before any policy result; category familiarity only, exact training-instance exposure unverified.

interface.rgb_order: right,left,front,wrist from upstream 4-camera source; validate ncam=4 and save first image grid before inference
interface.state: xyz relative to [0,-0.4,0.78], Euler xyz radians from wxyz quaternion, upstream raw gripper flag; 7 dimensions
interface.gripper_state_caveat: Pinned Franka get_ee_open_state returns True when both finger qpos < 0.035 and carries an upstream BUG comment. Retain the checkpoint-facing raw convention without silently inverting it. Save raw EE state; do not treat this flag as verified open/released state.
interface.action: Absolute EE xyz/Euler in robot-offset frame plus gripper; policy output transform already restores absolute actions. Do not add deltas again.
interface.controller: dm_control qpos_from_site_pose IK -> 7 joints + 2 finger controls; one env.step per action; abort on IK failure and non-finite outputs
interface.termination: Check task.conditions.is_met explicitly; timestep.last alone is not success. First-hit native containment does not prove release/stability, distractor exclusion or final-set semantics.

research_gate.resume_after_success: Inspect saved frame/trace and native containment/release; only then design separate same-checkpoint set/enumeration comparison.
research_gate.on_failure: Distinguish install/assets/CUDA/EGL/IO/IK/budget vs task failure. No sweep or scientific NO-GO from resource failure.
unimplemented: paired state restoration and holdout split
